titleEn: Royal Decree on the Establishment of the National Supreme Council of Education

articles.en: The National Supreme Council of Education is hereby established as a national institution responsible for education policy before the Royal Government, abbreviated as N.S.C.E.

The National Supreme Council of Education shall be composed as follows: the Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Cambodia, President; the Deputy Prime Minister in charge of education, Vice-President; one eminent person, Vice-President; the Minister of Education, Youth and Sport, Permanent Vice-President; one Minister or Secretary of State of the Ministry of Labour and Vocational Training, member; one Minister or Secretary of State of the Office of the Council of Ministers, member; the Chairman or Vice-Chairman of the National Training Committee, member; the Chairman or Secretary-General of the National Committee for Quality Assurance in Education, member; one Minister or Secretary of State of the Ministry of Economy and Finance, member; one Minister or Secretary of State of the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, member; one Minister or Secretary of State of the Ministry of Health, member; one Minister or Secretary of State of the Ministry of Planning, member; one Minister or Secretary of State of the Ministry of Social Affairs, Veterans and Youth Rehabilitation, member; one Minister or Secretary of State of the Ministry of Women's Affairs, member; one Minister or Secretary of State of the Ministry of Culture and Fine Arts, member; one Minister or Secretary of State of the Ministry of Cults and Religions, member; one Minister or Secretary of State of the Ministry of Tourism, member; and a number of eminent persons with experience in education, politics, economics, science, technology and culture, members.

The National Supreme Council of Education shall have the following roles and duties: - to propose education policy and long-term strategy aimed at responding to the country's socio-economic development needs to the Royal Government; - to evaluate the work relating to the education, technical and vocational training sector as determined by the Royal Government; - to mobilise all resources in the service of the cause of education.
The organisation and functioning of the National Supreme Council of Education shall be determined by sub-decree.
Any provisions contrary to this Royal Decree shall be considered null and void.

Samdech Akka Moha Sena Padei Techo Hun Sen, Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Cambodia, shall implement this Royal Decree from the date of signature onwards.
Done at Phnom Penh, 27 March 2009, in the Royal name and by Royal command; Acting Head of State, signature and Royal seal; respectfully submitted to the King for signature by Samdech Akka Moha Thomma Pothisal Chea Sim, Regent of the Kingdom of Cambodia; Prime Minister, signature, Samdech Akka Moha Sena Padei Techo Hun Sen; No. 320 Ch.L.; certified true copy for distribution, Phnom Penh, 02 April 2009, Deputy Secretary-General of the Royal Government, Khun Chin Phen.
